purpose: Define one machine-readable result envelope for every Contract Format 1.4 validation run, preserving validator identity/version, target graph, dimensions, findings and evidence references.

topics.name: Validation Result Model
topics.purpose: Define one machine-readable result envelope for every Contract Format 1.4 validation run, preserving validator identity/version, target graph, dimensions, findings and evidence references.

semantics.dimension_rule: Each validation dimension retains its own state and findings.
semantics.aggregation_rule: overall pass requires all mandatory dimensions to pass or be covered by an explicitly permitted exception contract.
semantics.target_rule: Result identifies the exact validated target/snapshot and cannot be reused for a changed graph.
semantics.validator_rule: Validator implementation/version is explicit for reproducibility.
semantics.nonauthority_rule: Validation result reports source conformance; it does not mutate source semantics.
semantics.immutability_rule: Completed result is immutable evidence; a rerun creates a new result identity.

invariants.rule: Validation outcomes, findings, exceptions, evidence, baselines and release decisions are explicit machine-readable facts and never silently rewrite source semantics.

hard_gates.condition: validation result lacks exact target snapshot
dimension failure hidden by overall pass

references.purpose: Repository acceptance consumes dimensioned validation results.
